selection: For each fixed source, take 100 lowest identity hashes of game, step and callback ordinal; independent of labels, model scores and economic outcomes.
budget: One synthetic membership probe; then two trace streams, one complete decode each, and at most 400 CPU forwards across two frozen models and 120000 combined candidate rows.
metrics: Top-1 agreement and teacher rank by model and teacher operation plus paired both/new-only/old-only/neither totals.
boundary: These are previously recorded teacher-task development trajectories on training seeds, omitted from the eight training source games. They are not independent holdout, new-seed generalization, economic causation or promotion evidence.
failure_policy: One attempt only; source, label, sample, identity, budget, membership, cleanup or inference failure stops with no replacement, resampling or retry.
